reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune. Imported from CCEH tune 000757 (the melody read from 000757a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Horatio Richmond Palmer's dates (1834–1907) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Palmer_HR (Palmer, H. R. (Horatio Richmond), 1834-1907; 'was born April 26, 1834'); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/nr92011120 (Palmer, H. R. (Horatio Richmond), 1834-1907); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000757a.nwc). The tune ends on E, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
